answer: Each identity binds one registered master farrier: 4 years' training, a state exam and forge inspection. Every shoe carries the farrier's sparrow punch-mark, logged against the horse's chip; one farrier backs one identity. Per fake: one real farrier, 1,800 units, 1,460 days; 100 fakes cost 180,000 units and 400 farrier-years. Cheapest cheat: hiring a farrier to shoe for another identity — the lender surrenders the registration behind their own identity, and a forged log fails because each shoeing threads the chip number into the register and the atlas of forges lists only licensed forges.
